title: Deer wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- deer body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#c97b3a'/>
  <!-- deer chest lighter patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='15' ry='11' fill='#e8a95c'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='35' y='86' width='5' height='11' rx='2' fill='#a85e28'/>
  <rect x='60' y='86' width='5' height='11' rx='2' fill='#a85e28'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='42' y='55' width='16' height='18' rx='7' fill='#c97b3a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='18' ry='15' fill='#d98a4a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='33' rx='5' ry='9' fill='#c97b3a' transform='rotate(-25 32 33)'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='33' rx='5' ry='9' fill='#c97b3a' transform='rotate(25 68 33)'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='33' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#e8a95c' transform='rotate(-25 32 33)'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='33' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#e8a95c' transform='rotate(25 68 33)'/>
  <!-- antlers -->
  <path d='M38 32 L33 18 M33 18 L27 14 M33 18 L35 12' stroke='#e8c070' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 32 L67 18 M67 18 L73 14 M67 18 L65 12' stroke='#e8c070' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='43' r='3' fill='#3a2418'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='43' r='3' fill='#3a2418'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='42' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='42' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='53' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#e8a95c'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='51' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#5a3018'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M47 55 Q50 58 53 55' stroke='#a85e28' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <path d='M50 14 L38 34 L62 34 Z' fill='#ff5a8a'/>
  <path d='M50 14 L44 24 L50 30 L56 24 Z' fill='#ffd23a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='13' r='3.5' fill='#4ac9ff'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='29' r='1.8' fill='#4ac9ff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='29' r='1.8' fill='#4ac9ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='1.8' fill='#4ac9ff'/>
  <!-- hat rim -->
  <rect x='37' y='32' width='26' height='3.5' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd23a'/>
</svg>
